components.name: VxWorks RTOS Base Layer
components.description: 상용 실시간 운영체제 기반 계층. 결정적 태스크 스케줄링과 하드웨어 추상화를 제공한다.

components.name: libxml2
components.description: IEC 61850 SCL, PLCopen XML 등 설정 파일 파싱에 사용하는 XML 처리기.

components.name: NTP Daemon
components.description: 이벤트 타임스탬프 정합성을 위한 시각 동기화 데몬.

components.name: Expat
components.description: 스트림 방식 XML 파서. 장치 기술 파일과 프로젝트 설정 처리에 사용된다.

components.name: zlib
components.description: 펌웨어 이미지와 로그 압축/해제에 사용되는 무손실 압축 라이브러리.

components.name: Net-SNMP
components.description: 네트워크 관리 시스템이 장비 상태를 폴링할 수 있게 하는 SNMP 에이전트.

components.name: libmodbus
components.description: Modbus RTU/TCP 마스터·슬레이브 프레임 처리 라이브러리.

components.name: CODESYS Control Runtime System
components.description: IEC 61131-3 프로그램을 실행하는 제어 런타임. 온라인 변경과 통신 서버를 포함한다.

components.name: SCADAPack Time Synchronization Service
components.description: NTP/PTP 기반 시각 동기화와 이벤트 타임스탬프 정합성을 유지하는 서비스.

components.name: SCADAPack Control Execution Engine
components.description: 제어 로직 스캔 사이클을 실행하고 I/O 이미지 테이블을 갱신하는 핵심 실행 엔진.

components.name: SCADAPack Firmware Update Agent
components.description: 서명 검증을 포함한 펌웨어 이미지 수신, 검증, 활성화 절차를 수행하는 업데이트 에이전트.

components.name: SCADAPack Diagnostics and Event Logger
components.description: 장비 상태 이벤트, 진단 코드, 감사 로그를 수집하고 보관하는 모듈.

components.name: SCADAPack Authentication and Access Control Service
components.description: 사용자 인증, 역할 기반 권한 부여, 세션 관리를 처리하는 접근 제어 서비스.

components.name: SCADAPack Embedded Web Configuration UI
components.description: 브라우저 기반 설정 및 상태 조회 화면을 제공하는 내장 웹 애플리케이션.

components.name: DNP3 Outstation Stack
components.description: DNP3 아웃스테이션 구현. 이벤트 클래스 폴링과 비요청 응답을 처리한다.

components.name: Modbus/TCP Protocol Stack
components.description: Modbus TCP 서버/클라이언트 기능. 레지스터 및 코일 접근 요청을 처리한다.

components.name: IEC 60870-5-104 Telecontrol Stack
components.description: 원방감시제어 통신 규약 스택. ASDU 송수신과 시간 동기를 처리한다.

vulnerabilities.description: Buffer overflow in the decodearr function in ntpq in ntp 4.2.8p6 through 4.2.8p10 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code by leveraging an ntpq query and sending a response with a crafted array.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: addBinding in xmlparse.c in Expat (aka libexpat) before 2.4.3 has an integer overflow.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: Expat (aka libexpat) before 2.4.4 has a signed integer overflow in XML_GetBuffer, for configurations with a nonzero XML_CONTEXT_BYTES.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: xmltok_impl.c in Expat (aka libexpat) before 2.4.5 lacks certain validation of encoding, such as checks for whether a UTF-8 character is valid in a certain context.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: Net-SNMP through 5.8 has Improper Privilege Management because SNMP WRITE access to the EXTEND MIB provides the ability to run arbitrary commands as root.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: The ctl_getitem method in ntpd in ntp-4.2.8p6 before 4.2.8p11 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (out-of-bounds read) via a crafted mode 6 packet with a ntpd instance from 4.2.8p6 through 4.2.8p10.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: ntpd in ntp 4.2.8p4 before 4.2.8p11 drops bad packets before updating the "received" timestamp, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (disruption) by sending a packet with a zero-origin timestamp causing the association to reset and setting the contents of the packet as the most recent timestamp. This issue is a result of an incomplete fix for CVE-2015-7704.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: _set_key in agent/helpers/table_container.c in Net-SNMP before 5.8 has a NULL Pointer Exception bug that can be used by an authenticated attacker to remotely cause the instance to crash via a crafted UDP packet, resulting in Denial of Service.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: net-snmp before 5.8.1.pre1 has a double free in usm_free_usmStateReference in snmplib/snmpusm.c via an SNMPv3 GetBulk request. NOTE: this affects net-snmp packages shipped to end users by multiple Linux distributions, but might not affect an upstream release.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: libxml2 through 2.11.5 has a use-after-free that can only occur after a certain memory allocation fails. This occurs in xmlUnlinkNode in tree.c. NOTE: the vendor's position is "I don't think these issues are critical enough to warrant a CVE ID ... because an attacker typically can't control when memory allocations fail."

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.
